MossPanelDatasetFlexible.description: Pick a manga panel layout from preview images and build the MOSS prompt from the shared characters and each panel's content.

コマ割り.name: Layout
コマ割り.tooltip: Press "Choose a layout from images" to pick from previews. Panel inputs are added or removed automatically.

生成内容.name: Output
生成内容.tooltip: "Manga" draws characters and dialogue. "Empty panel frames" draws only the panel borders.

MossMangaCharacters.description: Names and appearance of up to three characters shared by all panels.

人物1_名前.name: Character 1 name
人物1_名前.tooltip: A name for your own reference. Any language is fine.

人物1_外見.name: Character 1 appearance
人物1_外見.tooltip: Describe the appearance in English, or connect the output of "Character appearance (image / text)".

人物2_名前.name: Character 2 name
人物2_名前.tooltip: A name for your own reference. Any language is fine.

人物2_外見.name: Character 2 appearance
人物2_外見.tooltip: Describe the appearance in English, or connect the output of "Character appearance (image / text)".

人物3_名前.name: Character 3 name
人物3_名前.tooltip: Fill in both the name and the appearance only when you use a third character.

人物3_外見.name: Character 3 appearance
人物3_外見.tooltip: English appearance text, or the output of the appearance extraction node. Leave both name and appearance empty for two characters.

MossMangaPanel.description: The scene, characters, and up to three lines of dialogue for one panel.

場面.name: Scene
場面.tooltip: Describe the scene in English. It is passed to MOSS as is, without translation.

登場人物.name: Characters
登場人物.tooltip: Characters who appear in this panel. Every speaker must be one of them.

話者1.name: Speaker 1
話者1.tooltip: Who says line 1. Choose a character included in "Characters", or "No dialogue".

セリフ1.name: Line 1
セリフ1.tooltip: Enter only the text, in the language you want rendered. It is passed as is, without translation.

話者2.name: Speaker 2
話者2.tooltip: Who says line 2. Choose a character included in "Characters", or "No dialogue".

セリフ2.name: Line 2
セリフ2.tooltip: Enter only the text, in the language you want rendered. No translation is applied.

構図.name: Composition
構図.tooltip: Optional. Connect "Composition for panel" from "Choose a composition (preview images)". The character count must match.

話者3.name: Speaker 3
話者3.tooltip: Who says line 3. Choose a character included in "Characters", or "No dialogue".

セリフ3.name: Line 3
セリフ3.tooltip: A third line. It is passed to MOSS as is.

MossPromptEditor.description: Shows the prompt sent to MOSS and lets you send an edited version instead.

使うプロンプト.name: Prompt to use
使うプロンプト.tooltip: "Edited text" sends the content of the edit box below to MOSS.

編集用プロンプト.name: Edited prompt
編集用プロンプト.tooltip: If empty, the received prompt is filled in after a run. Keep it valid JSON when editing.

MossCompositionTemplate.description: Pick a camera composition for one, two, or three characters from preview images.

構図テンプレート.name: Composition template
構図テンプレート.tooltip: Press "Choose a composition from images" to pick from previews.

MossCharacterAppearance.description: Pass a character's appearance as text, or extract it from a reference image with the MOSS Qwen.

指定方法.name: Method
指定方法.tooltip: "Text only" passes the appearance prompt as is. The other methods extract the appearance from the reference image.

外見プロンプト.name: Appearance prompt
外見プロンプト.tooltip: For "Text only", describe the appearance in English. With an image, you can add details such as hair color or clothing. Put pose and background in the panel's scene.

最大トークン数.name: Max tokens
最大トークン数.tooltip: Maximum length of the extracted appearance text.

Qwen.name: Qwen
Qwen.tooltip: You can share the CLIPLoader (type=moss_image) output used for MOSS generation. Not evaluated for "Text only".

参考画像.name: Reference image
参考画像.tooltip: Connect one image that shows the character from a Load Image node. If needed, it is downscaled to 768 px on the long side for analysis only.
